subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Most of the students in the first year were unable to score good marks due to their __________ nature.
solution:
The correct answer is '**nonchalant**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**nonchalant**" means feeling or appearing casually calm and relaxed. (बेख़बर)
 
• A nonchalant attitude may lead to a lack of attention and poor performance in academics.
 
• The other options: "**deliberate**," "**concerned**," and "**enthusiastic**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Most of the students in the first year were unable to score good marks due to their nonchalant__ nature.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Deliberate (सोच-समझ कर किया गया)**: done consciously and intentionally.
 
• **Concerned (चिंतित)**: worried, troubled, or anxious.
 
• **Enthusiastic (उत्साही)**: having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
